comparison.objective: Operate an extinguisher by pulling its safety pin, aiming the horn, and squeezing the handle.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential pin extraction, hose/horn aiming, and trigger actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title is available; aim, discharge duration, fire suppression, and safety thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: The pin is intentionally extracted intact and remains an accessory to extinguisher operation. The candidate must fracture four manufactured tangs by controlled impacts and recover the newly free fragments without coil damage. No body details or spec versions were provided.
